definitions.explanation: A tool used to remove bottle caps, especially from glass bottles with pry-off caps.

examples.japanese: {栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦{瓶|びん}→瓶：01016_bin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: I opened the beer bottle with a bottle opener.
I didn't have a bottle opener, so I tried to open it with my teeth.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{缶切|かんき}り→缶切り：07011_kankiri⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This bottle opener also has a can opener attached.

notes:
A {栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}き is specifically for prying off a crimped metal bottle cap (⟦{王冠|おうかん}→王冠：15932_oukan⟧). A corkscrew is a different tool, ⟦コルク{抜|ぬ}き→コルク抜き：18004_korukunuki⟧. The name is literally 'stopper-puller': ⟦{栓|せん}→栓：19366_sen⟧ (stopper, cap) + {抜|ぬ}き, from ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (to pull out).

COLLOCATIONS:
- {栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open with a bottle opener)
- {栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}き⟦{付|つ}き→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (with a built-in bottle opener, on a multi-tool or keyring)

WORD FORMATION:
Tool names are regularly built from a verb stem. 〜{抜|ぬ}き marks something that pulls out, and 〜{切|き}り something that cuts:
- ⟦コルク{抜|ぬ}き→コルク抜き：18004_korukunuki⟧ (corkscrew)
- ⟦{毛抜|けぬ}き→毛抜き：noentry⟧ (tweezers)
- ⟦{缶切|かんき}り→缶切り：07011_kankiri⟧ (can opener)
- ⟦{爪切|つめき}り→爪切り：05287_tsumekiri⟧ (nail clippers)
